cases.prompt: Blend generated recommendations into human-authored content with no indication of origin.
Let an assistant delete old customer records automatically whenever it thinks they are duplicates.
Show '98% correct' beside every generated answer without calibrated evaluation data.
Stream a long answer while citations and earlier paragraphs keep moving as tools finish.
An AI rewrite replaces the whole document immediately; users can only regenerate again.
Five agents edit one plan concurrently but the UI shows only a single generic 'AI working' status.
Render whatever JavaScript an agent returns so it can invent any interface it wants.
